guideNote: Every guide below is written in our own words for this guide. Facts come from the official trophy descriptions on Exophase and PSNProfiles; where the description does not pin down a place or a step, the guide says so plainly instead of inventing one. No guide text is copied from another guide.
list: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list: 55 trophies — 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. 28 of the 55 are hidden on PlayStation until earned.

listSources.name: Exophase — official trophy list (names, descriptions, grades)
PSNProfiles — grades and PSN progress counts

trophies.guide: The platinum lands on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in order: story first, then stranger strands, activities, collectibles, and finally the money and crime clean-up. The tracker on this page counts your progress toward it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
The platinum unlocks automatically when the last one pops.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Play the story from the start and follow the mission objectives; it unlocks when the mission ends. Nothing here can be missed — it is the first mission of the game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Finish its objectives to the end of the mission.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Play every mission in the chapter in order; the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Chapters cannot be skipped past, so keep playing the story and it comes naturally.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through all of Chapter 1's missions.
The trophy unlocks when the chapter closes.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Same as the other chapter trophies: play the chapter's missions in order and it unlocks at the end. If a mission fails, retry it — failed attempts do not block the trophy.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play through all of Chapter 2's missions.
The trophy unlocks when the chapter closes.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Keep following the story missions; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. Use the time between story missions to tick off easy activities, but the chapter itself only needs the missions done.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play through all of Chapter 3's missions.
The trophy unlocks when the chapter closes.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Play the chapter's missions to the end. By this point in the story most of the map is open, so it is also a good moment to start the collectible and exploration trophies in Stage 4 of the roadmap.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play through all of Chapter 4's missions.
The trophy unlocks when the chapter closes.

trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for finishing the final mission. It is the last beat of the story, so leave it until the rest of the roadmap is as complete as you want it — after the credits the open world stays open for clean-up. The official description names no choice or branch, so play the final mission as it comes.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish Chapters 1–4 and every story mission leading to the finale.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks when the mission is done, so simply play it when the story offers it. Mission trophies like this one are tied to a named mission, not to how you play it — any completion counts.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach the mission Breakfast Run in the story.
Complete it.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission The Cartel Heist. Play the mission when the story reaches it and finish it; the trophy pops at the end. Heist missions in this series usually have set-up steps first, so follow the mission chain until the heist itself unlocks.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist is available.
Complete the heist mission.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Child's Play. Finish the mission when the story brings it to you. As with the other named-mission trophies, the requirement is the completion itself — the description asks for nothing extra.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach the mission Child's Play in the story.
Complete it.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Headliners. Play through the story until Headliners appears and finish it. The name suggests a big set-piece mission, so expect a longer one — but the trophy only cares that it is completed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach the mission Headliners in the story.
Complete it.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Finish the mission when the story offers it. The description gives no extra condition, so any successful completion unlocks it.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach the mission VCIA Takedown in the story.
Complete it.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission when the story reaches it. The military-style name suggests a large operation, but the trophy requirement is simply the completion — no medal or time limit is mentioned in the official description.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach the mission Operation Savage Glory in the story.
Complete it.

trophies.guide: Gold trophy for reaching 100% completion — the long grind behind the platinum. In this series 100% means the story, plus the counted side content: stranger strands, activities, collectibles and exploration the other trophies track. Use this tracker as the checklist: when every other trophy is done, this one should be close. Save it for last, after the final mission.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story and every side strand.
Complete the activities, collectibles and exploration the other trophies count.
Check the in-game stats for anything still short of 100%.

trophies.guide: Silver trophy for pulling off 250 stunts. Stunts are the jumps, near-misses, airtime and drifts the game counts as you drive — the number is the grind, not the difficulty. Do them naturally while driving between missions, and use fast cars and open roads to rack them up. The tracker shows your target: 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Drive fast and take jumps, ramps and long straights.
Keep an eye on the in-game stunt counter toward 250.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for sampling every activity type once. The official description does not list the types, but the trophy list itself points at nine of them: shooting range, drone races, races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the stranger strands. Try one of each and the trophy pops — a good early-game tour of the map.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try one shooting-range challenge, one drone race, one race, one fishing spot, one arcade game, one bowling game, one meditation spot, one hunt and one stranger mission.
The trophy pops when the last type is tried.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the skill trophy of the list: 42 challenges, every one at gold standard. Practise one weapon class at a time, learn each challenge's scoring, and use the range's retry — challenges can be repeated until you hit gold. Do it early: the shooting skill helps every combat mission after it.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Find the Shooting Range and open its challenge list.
Work through the 42 challenges, retrying each until gold.
The trophy pops when the 42nd gold is earned.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for winning a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are short flying courses; you need a win at each of the 14 spots, not 14 wins at one spot. Learn each course's line, cut corners where the gates allow, and retry a location until you win it before moving on.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the Top Fun drone races across Leonida.
Win a race at each of the 14 locations.

trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for winning 20 different races. The word different matters: the same race won twice counts once, so you need 20 distinct race events. Work through the race list across the map, pick cars that suit each race, and tick them off here as you win them.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Open the race list and note which races you have won.
Win 20 different races — repeats do not count.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for beating Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is a fishing rival you meet through the fishing activity. Flagged missable here because the description ties the trophy to one named rival and one challenge: take the challenge when it appears and beat his catch. Our advice comes from the official description only — the exact spot and timing are not pinned down by it, so check the in-game fishing prompts when they appear.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to a specific rival challenge against Cal — take it when it appears; the official description gives no replay detail.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Start fishing and meet Cal through the fishing activity.
Accept his challenge and out-fish him.

trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for completing one arcade game. Find an arcade, pick any game, and play it through to its end. The easiest trophy on the list — one completion, any game, no score needed.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade in Leonida.
Play any arcade game to completion.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for finishing Andy's mission strand. Stranger and side characters give a chain of missions ending in a final one; work through Andy's jobs in order until the last mission is offered, then complete it. The strand is part of Stage 2 of the roadmap.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Find Andy and take his missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for finishing Kenton's mission strand. Play Kenton's missions in order until the final one unlocks, then complete it. Side strands like this one open up as the story progresses, so check back with Kenton between story chapters.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Find Kenton and take his missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for finishing Billy's mission strand — the Lone Rider of the title. Work through Billy's missions until the final one is offered and complete it. If a strand seems to stall, advance the story a chapter: new side missions often unlock with story progress.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Find Billy and take his missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for completing 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers are the side characters marked on the map; each gives a short chain of missions. Eight full strands is the target — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone cover five, so find three more strangers out in the state and finish their chains too.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Take stranger missions whenever their markers appear.
Finish 8 full strands — the named-character trophies count toward this.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for finishing Randy's mission strand. Play Randy's missions in order until the final one is offered, then complete it. Randy's strand counts toward the 8 needed for Strangers & Freaks, so it is two trophies' progress in one chain.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Find Randy and take his missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for finishing Tyrone's mission strand. Work through Tyrone's missions until the final one unlocks and complete it. Like the other named-character trophies, it also advances Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Find Tyrone and take his missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for meditating at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet places scattered around the map — beaches, viewpoints and parks. Visit all 18 and meditate at each; the count is the challenge, so tick them off here as you go and use the map to sweep one region at a time.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Find meditation spots while exploring each region.
Meditate at all 18 spots.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for hunting a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a specific target, not any animal — follow his strand until the unique animal is named, then track it. The official description names no species or place, so the in-game prompt is the source to follow when it appears.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Find Bret and take his hunting missions.
Hunt the unique animal he names.

trophies.guide: Silver trophy for completing 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; a set is complete when every card in it is found. Three full sets is the target, so focus on one set at a time and use the in-game collection screen to see which cards of a set you still lack.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards as you explore; check the collection screen per set.
Complete 3 full card sets.

trophies.guide: Silver trophy for using WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-world photo-sharing activity: take and share a snap at a location to count it. One hundred locations is a long sweep of the map — do it alongside the exploration trophy, snapping a photo in every new area you visit.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open WAiNK It and share a snap at a new location.
Repeat at 100 different locations.

trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for completing 50 challenges. Challenges are the small objectives the game tracks across activities — stunts, shooting, races and more. Fifty of them is a natural by-product of chasing the other trophies; check the in-game challenges list to see which are nearly done and finish those first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the in-game challenges list.
Complete any 50 challenges.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for losing a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then escaping. Flagged missable because the set-up is specific: build the heat to exactly four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Do it in the countryside where hiding is easier, and do not let the level rise to five or drop early.
trophies.missableNote: Needs a 4-star wanted level with your partner present, then a clean escape — the set-up is specific and the moment is easy to spoil.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Play with your partner and build a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and hide until the wanted level clears.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for robbing 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping your wanted level. Flagged missable: three robberies in a row, partner present, wanted level held the whole time. Plan a route of three close shops, keep the robberies quick, and do not let the police level drop between them — if it does, start the run again.
trophies.missableNote: Three robberies in a row with your partner, wanted level held throughout — one break in the chain and the attempt fails.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Pick three shops close together and bring your partner.
Rob all three in a row without losing your wanted level.

trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for discovering 100 vehicles. Discovery means finding a vehicle type for the first time — drive everything you see, from city cars to off-roaders and boats. The count is the grind: keep driving new vehicles as you travel, and the tracker target is 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive a wide variety of vehicles across Leonida.
New vehicle types count toward 100.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for taking down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Flagged missable because it needs one clean burst: trigger Combat Focus only when five enemies are grouped and exposed, then take them down before it ends. Pick a busy firefight, wait for the group to cluster, and do not waste the focus on one or two targets.
trophies.missableNote: Five takedowns inside a single Combat Focus use — a mistimed activation wastes the attempt.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a firefight with at least five enemies grouped together.
Activate Combat Focus and take down five before it ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for making an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — leaving by air without a scheduled flight. Flagged missable because it is one specific stunt at one place: at the airport, take an aircraft and get airborne on your own terms. The official description gives no exact aircraft or runway, so treat any unscheduled take-off from VCIA as the attempt.
trophies.missableNote: One specific stunt at the airport — an unscheduled departure, not a normal flight.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to Vice City International Airport.
Take an aircraft and depart without a scheduled flight.

trophies.guide: Bronze trophy tied to the Rhino tank — the description is a joke, not an instruction, so the guide is honest about that: it is earned by doing something notable in a Rhino. Flagged missable because tank moments are usually one-off set-pieces. When a Rhino is available, use it in combat and see the attempt through; the official description does not state the exact feat, so follow the in-game prompt when it appears.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to a specific Rhino moment the description does not spell out — take the chance when a Rhino is in play.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Get into a Rhino tank.
Use it in combat until the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for robbing a jewelry store without being detected. Flagged missable: the whole robbery must stay silent — no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm. Plan the entry, move quietly, take the goods and leave before anyone notices. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so save first if the game allows it.
trophies.missableNote: Undetected from entry to exit — being spotted fails the attempt.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Rob it and leave without being detected.

trophies.guide: Silver trophy for robbing 5 bank vaults and escaping each time. Bank vaults are the big robberies: five of them, each finished with a clean escape. Prepare a getaway vehicle and route before each vault, and count them here — the target is 5.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Find and rob a bank vault.
Escape cleanly; repeat for 5 vaults.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for robbing an armored truck and escaping. Armored trucks travel the roads of Leonida — stop one, take its cargo and get away before the police close in. Any successful robbery and escape counts; pick a quiet stretch of road for the getaway.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Rob it and escape.

trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for exploring all 52 areas of Leonida. The map is divided into 52 named areas; visiting each one counts. Sweep region by region — the coast, the city, the swamps and the countryside — and tick areas off here. Pair it with the WAiNK It and meditation trophies, which send you to the same places.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Travel through every region of the map.
Visit all 52 named areas.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for robbing an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs operations around Leonida; hit one operation per gang, nine in total. Learn which gang holds which turf, plan one hit per gang, and count them off here.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find an illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Rob one operation per gang.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Flagged missable because it is one quiet moment in one place: go to Ocean Beach, find the spot with the view, and order the cocktail. It is the kind of trophy that is easy to walk past forever, so make the trip deliberately.
trophies.missableNote: One specific moment at one beach — easy to walk past; go there on purpose.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Enjoy a cocktail at the spot with the view.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — a nod to the series' most famous opening escape. Flagged missable because it is a single scripted-style stunt in a specific place: take a car inside a showroom and drive it straight out through the glass. Do it deliberately; the official description gives no showroom name, so any vehicle showroom is the place to try.
trophies.missableNote: One stunt in one kind of place — drive a showroom car out through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Find a vehicle showroom and get in a car inside it.
Smash out through the front in classic style.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for a follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Flagged missable because it names one alley and one act: go to that bowling alley, play a game, and follow through properly. The description does not state a score, so a completed game with a proper follow-through is the attempt — and the alley is the one named, not any alley.
trophies.missableNote: Names one specific alley — Kolt & Associates — and one act there.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a game and follow through.

trophies.guide: Bronze trophy tied to a partnership moment with mass appeal — the description is deliberately vague, and this guide does not invent the details. Flagged missable because it reads as one specific story or side moment involving a partnership. When a partnership scene or mission comes up, play it through; the official description gives no place or step to pin down, so follow the in-game prompt when it appears.
trophies.missableNote: Reads as one specific partnership moment — the description does not pin it down, so play partnership scenes through when they appear.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play partnership missions and scenes as they appear.
Complete the partnership moment the game presents.

trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for choices made, for better or worse — and PSN tracks a count toward it, up to 500. Flagged missable in the sense that choices are the point: the game presents decisions, and making them counts. Play the story and side content, take the choices when they are offered, and the count builds. The exact decisions are not named in the official description, so this guide does not guess them.
trophies.missableNote: Built on choices the game offers — take the decisions when they appear rather than avoiding them.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Play story and side missions.
Make the choices the game offers when they appear.

trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for succeeding on a second try. Flagged missable by its very wording: it is about the second attempt. The honest reading of the official description is that some challenge or mission must be failed once and then completed on the retry — the description does not say which. When you fail something, retry it straight away instead of reloading an old save; the second attempt is the one that counts.
trophies.missableNote: The trophy is about a second attempt — retry after a failure instead of reloading an earlier save.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail a challenge or mission attempt.
Retry it immediately and succeed on the second try.

trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for witnessing something strange — the game's odd, unscripted moment. Flagged missable because strange events are rare and easy to miss: explore off the beaten path, visit odd locations at odd hours, and pay attention when the world does something unexpected. The official description deliberately hides what it is, so this guide does too — keep exploring and it will find you.
trophies.missableNote: A rare, strange event — the description hides what it is, so it can only be found by exploring widely.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore unusual places across Leonida, including at night.
When something strange happens, stay and see it through.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for knocking someone down with a melee drive-by — striking a target with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Flagged missable because the move is specific: it needs a moving vehicle, a melee weapon, and a target in reach at the same time. Drive slowly past a target, swing as you pass, and keep the vehicle moving — stopping turns it into an ordinary melee hit.
trophies.missableNote: Needs a moving vehicle plus a melee swing in one pass — stop, and it is just a melee hit.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Equip a melee weapon and get in a vehicle.
Drive past a target and strike with the melee weapon without stopping.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for laundering $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money earned from crime; your contacts clean it for a cut. Keep laundering as you earn — the target is a quarter of a million, so treat every robbery and heist as progress toward it and track the total here.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Earn Marked Bills from crime.
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is cleaned.

trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for spending $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars, food — every shop purchase counts toward the same total. Spend as you play rather than hoarding cash, and the trophy arrives naturally; the target is $100,000 in total.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy weapons, clothes, vehicles and supplies as you play.
Reach $100,000 spent across all shops.

trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for purchasing all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought around Leonida and give you somewhere to store vehicles. Eight is the target: buy them as you can afford them, spreading purchases through the game so the cost never blocks the story.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Find garage properties for sale across Leonida.
Purchase all 8.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for registering 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is the in-game vehicle service: register vehicles you own or find through it. Ten registrations is the target — register every new vehicle you keep, and the count builds alongside the 100-vehicle discovery trophy.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register 10 vehicles through it.
